articles.summary: The Board of Directors of Jacobs has declared a quarterly cash dividend payable to shareholders in the amount of $0.36 per share of Jacobs common stock.
articles.title: Jacobs declares quarterly dividend

articles.summary: A Jacobs and AECOM joint venture has been appointed to Iarnród Éireann’s (Irish Rail’s) new Multi-Disciplinary Consultancy Framework, establishing a long-term relationship to support the development and delivery of rail infrastructure projects across Ireland.
articles.title: Jacobs and AECOM joint venture appointed to Iarnród Éireann’s (Irish Rail’s) new consultancy framework

articles.summary: Jacobs has been appointed by Cochin International Airport Limited to develop a comprehensive 25-year master plan for Cochin International Airport in Kochi, Kerala, India.
articles.title: Jacobs to develop 25-year master plan for Cochin International Airport in India

articles.summary: Jacobs has been reappointed by Transport Infrastructure Ireland to provide technical advisory services for the operation and management of Ireland’s major road tunnels and its Motorway Operations Control Centre.
articles.title: Jacobs reappointed to support Ireland’s road tunnels

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected by ACCIONA to provide multidisciplinary design and project delivery services for the Warkworth to Te Hana Ara Tūhono section of New Zealand's Northland Corridor highway program.
articles.title: Jacobs selected for major New Zealand highway project
